access_note: Access was tested from a US network on the check date. Several Indian government portals (Agmarknet, data.gov.in API, agriwelfare.gov.in) refuse non-Indian connections; they work from India.

items.name: Agmarknet
items.what: Daily min / max / modal prices and arrivals from ~3,000 APMC markets for 300+ commodities, by variety and grade.

items.name: data.gov.in – Daily mandi prices API
items.what: JSON/CSV API of the current day's Agmarknet prices (resource 9ef84268-d588-465a-a308-a864a43d0070). Free API key.
items.access: REST API with key; India IP

items.name: CEDA Agri-Market Data
items.org: Centre for Economic Data & Analysis, Ashoka University
items.what: Cleaned Agmarknet prices and arrivals mapped to Census 2011 districts; national, state and district series since 2008.
items.freq: Periodic (data to Oct 2025 on check date)

items.name: DoCA Price Monitoring System
items.what: Daily retail and wholesale prices of 38 essential items (incl. onion, potato, tomato, brinjal, banana) from 550+ centres. Homepage shows all-India averages.
items.access: Homepage open; detailed reports behind CAPTCHA

items.name: NHB Market Information
items.what: Daily, weekly and monthly wholesale, retail prices and arrivals for 31 centres (Lasalgaon, Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Shimla...) since 2000.

items.name: eNAM
items.what: Trades and prices on the national electronic market (~1,500 mandis).
items.access: Dashboard (trade-data endpoints returned errors on check date)

items.name: MSAMB
items.what: Daily APMC prices for Maharashtra: Lasalgaon, Pimpalgaon, Vashi, Pune, Solapur.

items.name: Krishi Marata Vahini
items.what: Daily prices and arrivals for Karnataka APMCs, incl. Kolar tomato.

items.name: NHRDF
items.what: Onion and garlic arrivals, prices and crop status reports.

items.name: Quick-commerce apps (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket)
items.what: Consumer prices by pin code and hour. No public API.

items.name: CPI (item indices)
items.what: Monthly consumer price indices incl. vegetables and fruit items.

items.name: WPI
items.org: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
items.what: Wholesale price index for onion, potato, fruits and vegetables.

items.name: RBI DBIE
items.what: Price series, inflation analysis and research on food inflation.

items.name: CRISIL Roti Rice Rate (thali cost)
items.what: Monthly cost of a home-cooked veg/non-veg thali, driven by onion, tomato, potato prices.

items.name: Horticulture area & production estimates
items.what: Advance and final estimates by crop and state.

items.name: UPAg
items.what: Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics: production, prices, trade in one place.

items.name: Horticultural Statistics at a Glance
items.what: Reference yearbook with state shares, district leaders, trade.

items.name: CHAMAN / MNCFC
items.what: Satellite-based area and production assessment of horticulture crops (incl. onion, potato, tomato, mango, banana, chilli).

items.name: Kharif / rabi sowing progress
items.what: Weekly area sown by crop during the season.

items.name: ICRISAT District Level Database
items.what: Long-run district-level area, production, prices.

items.name: FAOSTAT
items.what: Global production and trade for comparisons.

items.name: IMD
items.what: District rainfall, temperature, monsoon progress, heat-wave and cyclone warnings, extended-range forecasts.

items.name: Agromet Advisory Service (GKMS)
items.what: District crop-weather advisories every Tuesday and Friday.

items.name: Open-Meteo
items.what: Free historical and forecast weather API by latitude/longitude (ERA5 reanalysis).

items.name: NASA POWER
items.what: Agro-climatology data since 1981.

items.name: India-WRIS
items.what: Reservoir and groundwater levels (irrigation for onion, grapes, banana).

items.name: NABCONS post-harvest loss study
items.what: Crop-wise harvest and post-harvest losses for 2020-22.

items.name: ICAR-CIPHET loss study
items.what: Earlier national post-harvest loss estimates for 45 crops.

items.name: Cold-chain requirement study
items.what: Cold storage, pack-house, reefer and ripening-chamber gaps.

items.name: NCCD
items.what: Cold-chain standards, capacity and studies.

items.name: Operation Greens
items.what: Subsidies for transport and storage of TOP and other perishables in gluts.

items.name: Kisan Rail
items.what: Perishable parcel trains (2020–22) and parcel services.

items.name: RBI value-chain working papers (2024)
items.what: Farmer's share in the consumer rupee for TOP, fruits, pulses, dairy.

items.name: APEDA
items.what: Export statistics, product profiles, GrapeNet / MangoNet / HortiNet traceability.

items.name: TradeStat (DGCI&S)
items.what: Exports and imports by 8-digit HS code (0701 potato, 0702 tomato, 0703 onion, 0803 banana, 0804 mango, 0806 grapes, 0808 apple).

items.name: DGFT notifications
items.what: Export bans, minimum export prices, minimum import prices.

items.name: Price Stabilisation Fund
items.what: Onion buffer procurement and release; subsidised retail sales.

items.name: PIB
items.what: Official announcements: estimates, policy, buffer operations.

items.name: GI Registry
items.org: Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks
items.what: Geographical Indication tags (Alphonso, Nashik grapes, Jalgaon banana...).

items.name: FSSAI
items.what: Ripening rules (ethylene allowed, carbide banned), residue limits.

items.name: ICAR-DOGR (onion, garlic)
items.what: Varieties, storage research, crop advisories.

items.name: ICAR-CPRI (potato)
items.what: Kufri varieties, seed systems, late-blight forecasting.

items.name: ICAR-IIHR (vegetables, fruits)
items.what: Arka varieties for tomato, chilli, brinjal, mango and more.

items.name: ICAR-IIVR (vegetables)
items.what: Vegetable research and varieties.

items.name: ICAR-NRCB (banana)
items.what: Banana varieties, Fusarium TR4 management, post-harvest.

items.name: ICAR-CISH (mango)
items.what: Mango varieties (Amrapali, Mallika), flowering and pest management.

items.name: ICAR-CITH (apple)
items.what: Temperate fruit research, high-density apple.

items.name: ICAR-NRCG (grapes)
items.what: Grape varieties, residue management, export protocols.
